description_en: Queries the download records for query diagnostic information for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版查询诊断信息的下载记录
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-download-records --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --download-task-type SLOW_SQL --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDownloadRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The download task type. Valid values:

`SQL_DIAGNOSE`: SQL diagnosis.

`SLOW_SQL`: slow SQL query
parameters.help_zh:
下载任务类型。取值说明：
SQL_DIAGNOSE: SQL诊断。
SLOW_SQL: SQL慢查询
parameters.name: download_task_type
